Yunnan Germanium.why: InP substrate maker whose InP wafer demand and prices are rising with AI data-center optical communications (lasers and detectors); capacity expanding to 45 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent)
Yunnan Germanium.evidence: Yunnan Germanium IR activity record: 2026-009 (09-04-2026): compound-semiconductor demand rose sharply in H1 2026 on AI computing and data centers, with InP wafers for optical communications growing fastest; InP wafer customers are mainly epitaxy makers and device makers with their own epitaxy

players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): products are material-grade germanium (germanium ingots, germanium dioxide), solar germanium wafers, infrared germanium (single crystals and blanks, lenses, lens assemblies, thermal imagers, optical systems), germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, and compound-semiconductor materials - gallium arsenide wafers and indium phosphide wafers - used in infrared optoelectronics, solar cells, fiber communications, LEDs, VCSELs, high-power lasers and optical-communication lasers and detectors.

Management (IR record): in H1 2026 compound-semiconductor material demand rose significantly overall on the rapid build-out of AI computing and data centers, with demand for indium phosphide wafers used in optical communications growing especially fast; with supply and demand persistently tight, InP wafer prices also rose sharply - the industry showed rising volume and price together.

Management (IR record): customer demand for the company's InP wafers is mainly 3-4 inch - domestic customers mainly 3-inch, overseas customers mainly 4-inch; InP wafer customers are mainly epitaxy makers or device makers with their own epitaxy capability. Customer certification usually takes several months to a year or longer; InP certification already basically covers the well-known domestic downstream makers and the company is actively expanding overseas customers.

Management (IR record): the 'high-quality InP single-crystal wafer' project started in April 2026 with an 18-month construction period; it adds a line of 30 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent, including 6000 6-inch wafers) to existing capacity, for a final capacity of 45 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent); construction is advancing and capacity will be released progressively. Any further expansion will be disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: +30 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent, incl. 6000 6-inch); total 45 ten-thousand wafers/year; 18-month build from April 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the high-purity red phosphorus and high-purity indium that subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials uses for InP wafers are all bought externally, mainly from domestic suppliers; procurement is normal and meets production needs, and InP raw-material supply is normal.
Management (IR record): the company's main products are all on the export-control list; it has applied for export licences as required, and some orders have been approved and exported.
Management (IR record): InP wafer yield at subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao is, in the company's words, domestically leading and internationally advanced; InP wafer production has high technical barriers.

Management (IR record): in H1 2026 the germanium market saw the price centre of material-grade germanium move up significantly on tight raw-material supply (some domestic producers cut output on ore supply; recycled germanium below expectations), strategic revaluation and capital inflows. Fiber-grade germanium demand grew on AI computing infrastructure and data-center expansion, but price pass-through is still contested; infrared demand stayed weak on high germanium prices and substitute materials (chalcogenide glass); PV customers moved from annual to monthly tenders or tolling. Because the company changed fiber-grade germanium pricing to pass through costs and new-order negotiations lengthened, H1 fiber-grade germanium sales volume and revenue fell slightly year on year.

Management (IR record): the 'germanium wafers for space solar cells' project started in March 2025 with an 18-month construction period, to reach 125 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent) by end-2025 and 250 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent) when complete; construction is on plan.
quarterly_data.figure: 125 ten-thousand wafers/year by end-2025; 250 ten-thousand wafers/year at completion (4-inch equivalent)
